name: Amman
tagline: Hillside capital of ruins, falafel and the Dead Sea
summary: Amman spreads over hills of white stone, with a Roman theatre and citadel at its heart. Explore the Citadel's Temple of Hercules, eat at Hashem's falafel and Habibah's knafeh, wander Rainbow Street, then day-trip to the colonnades of Jerash and float in the Dead Sea.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are ideal; summers are hot and winters cool with occasional snow.
arrival: Queen Alia International is 45 minutes south of the city.
gettingAround: Taxis and Careem; hire a car or driver for day trips.
cashTip: Carry dinars for taxis, falafel and tips; the Jordan Pass covers the visa and many sites.
buyTip: Dead Sea products, olive oil and embroidery.
